discourse.excerpt: Do not crave for publicity; crave for the joy that shines in the faces of the people whom you help. Seva (selfless service) brings you nearer to Me.
discourse.theme: Seva is not for publicity — it is the quiet joy of the faces you help, and it brings you nearer to God.
discourse.title: No bumps, no jumps

reflection: Swami gives the Seva Dal its measuring stick: do the people you helped feel better and happier? That is the test — not the praise, not the publicity. Serve one person today quietly, with no one watching, and notice the joy in their face. That quiet joy is God coming nearer. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 13, 15 Nov 1975)
